title: Kagamine Rin — Cheering Front And Center!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, Rin.
You also came into contact with a fragment of a feeling, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd like to hear about that as well. Can you tell us which SEKAI you got to see?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The fragment I touched let me see Minori and the others' SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I learned so many cool things!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: First, that SEKAI almost came to be through just Haruka, Airi and Shizuku's feelings. But then...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The fragment... It's starting to fade...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sadly, those three did sort of have to see their worlds fall apart at one point...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I knew that their SEKAI would eventually be born, but I still felt so nervous and anxious.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Fortunately, the SEKAI we all know and love ended up becoming a reality.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Can you guess why?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. The addition of Minori's feelings, yes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Out of all the owners, she was the only one you didn't mention just now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Correct♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, their feelings had become intertwined long before they met each other at school...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! I didn't know that was how their SEKAI was born. I was so moved by their story!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But that also made me think...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: About what?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, you know how clovers are kind of a symbol of MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean, they even have some on their uniforms.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, what about those clovers?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What if Haruka and the others see Minori as their lucky four-leaf clover?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, she was the one who really brought all their feelings together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which allowed them all to rediscover their true feelings, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, good point!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so wonderfully poetic.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Isn't it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But Minori wasn't a smiling clover from the start. In that sense, it's incredible how much she's overcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. Her luck was so bad that she struggled to find success, which was terrible for her self-esteem...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But Haruka gave her the hope she needed. And Minori began working to become an idol just like her...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She kept trying, didn't give up on her feelings and was eventually the one to save Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Feelings are so powerful.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That means both reaching someone and being moved by someone can bring about a big change!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And our role is to sing songs based on such feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right! That is quite a powerful thought.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (All we can do is watch over them, but we can still sing for them with everything we have!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I hope my singing can bring positive change to people's lives someday.)
